summary: Remote DJ: optional automatic fresh-session reconnect after an involuntary loss (station switch, Off by default; bounded, cancellable; Remote Mic Off in every new session), an always-on leave-page warning, and explicit microphone and Web Audio cleanup. Apply additive library.0103, then restart Gunicorn and the engine (interrupts program audio and ends live Remote DJ sessions); no package, static, unit, nginx or protected-runtime change.
